columbina.note: read by eye: the six moon-disc stars on the crescent chain, from the end nearest the top left; the script had taken the glow of two of them for four points. Each point is the middle of its disc, where the star's spikes cross, and is not snapped: the bright part of each disc is a phase of the moon, off to one side, up to 9 px from the middle
